item.title: Calgary city councillors seek ways to crack down on shoplifting under $100
item.description: A motion from two Calgary city councillors asks administration to conduct "an analysis of approaches" that the city could take to regulate theft under $100.

item.title: Rosalind Smith honoured as trailblazer in Edmonton’s public school system
item.description: In 1996, Rosalind Smith made history as the first Black female principal for the Edmonton Public School Board.

item.title: Father of 1999 Taber school shooting victim on Tumbler Ridge: ‘A very helpless feeling’
item.description: The 1999 Taber school shooting claimed the life of Jason Lang, whose father Dale is sharing his wisdom and words of healing in light of the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: Porter becomes latest Canadian airline to restart service to Mexico
item.description: The announcement follows similar moves by Air Canada, WestJet and Air Transat on Monday. More than 26,000 Canadians in Mexico have registered with Ottawa.

item.title: ‘Makes me feel angry’: Lapu Lapu victim questions where donation money went
item.description: Alejandro Samper’s mother, Glitza, his father, Daniel, and his sister, Glitza, were killed after a vehicle rammed a crowd at the Lapu Lapu Festival in Vancouver on April 26.

item.title: Inmate escapes from Saskatchewan Penitentiary transport
item.description: Authorities say Keiston Custer, 30, absconded custody on Feb. 20 while being transported from Saskatchewan Penitentiary in Prince Albert, Sask.

item.title: ‘It’s always heartbreaking’: Multiple Okanagan wineries in foreclosure
item.description: In 2024 alone, at least a quarter of Okanagan wineries were listed for sale. Last year, roughly 20 were publicly on the market.

item.title: Trial delayed for man accused in B.C. anti-SOGI tractor chase
item.description: SOGI 123 is a resource package designed to help teachers and school administrators reduce discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in their curriculum.

item.title: Okanagan mom found support, help in group after son died from overdose
item.description: The Okanagan woman said her son David, who was 37 and a UBC student at the time, struggled with mental health and used substances to self-medicate.

item.title: Team Canada athletes welcomed home after 21-medal Olympic performance
item.description: Supporters gathered at airports in Toronto and Montreal, greeting athletes with signs, pom-poms and applause after Canada secured five gold medals.
